findings.description: Only real problems, one entry each. An empty array is the expected answer for healthy journeys.

code.description: The rubric item this finding belongs to. No other value is accepted.

journeyId.description: The journey the finding is about. Required for every code except entity.noReadSurface.

stepId.description: The step the finding points at, when one step is responsible.

subject.description: For entity.noReadSurface: the record whose current state no journey ever shows.

detail.description: One sentence, in the document's language, naming what is missing and for whom.
